title: int:Site
description: Pilot deployment location. Merges siteId (R2M) and pilotId (TUM). Subclass of cim:SubGeographicalRegion.

siteId.description: Primary identifier. IRI: int:siteId. UUID v4.

communityId.description: FK to Community. IRI: int:communityId. UUID v4.

description.description: General description of the pilot site. IRI: int:description.

latitude.description: Anonymised representative latitude. IRI: int:latitude. Unit: decimal degrees.

longitude.description: Anonymised representative longitude. IRI: int:longitude. Unit: decimal degrees.

facilityType.description: Building or facility type. IRI: s4bldg:buildingCategory.

marketMechanism.description: Energy sharing or trading mechanism. IRI: int:marketMechanism.

co2EmissionFactor.description: Grid CO2 emission factor. IRI: int:co2EmissionFactor. Unit: gCO2/kWh.

fromNodeId.description: Originating connectivity node for power flow. IRI: int:fromNodeId. UUID v4.

toNodeId.description: Destination connectivity node for power flow. IRI: int:toNodeId. UUID v4.

lineId.description: Line segment identifier. IRI: int:lineId. UUID v4.

operatorId.description: FK to operating Actor. IRI: int:operatorId. UUID v4.

connectedNodeId.description: Network connectivity node of the participant. IRI: int:connectedNodeId. UUID v4.

Conductance.description: Line conductance for Y-bus formulation. IRI: int:lineConductance. Unit: S.

lineSusceptance.description: Line susceptance for Y-bus formulation. IRI: int:lineSusceptance. Unit: S.

transformerReactance.description: Distribution transformer impedance. IRI: cim:transformerReactance. Unit: Ohm.

minNodeVoltage.description: Minimum allowable nodal voltage magnitude. IRI: int:minNodeVoltage. Unit: V or per unit.

maxNodeVoltage.description: Maximum allowable nodal voltage magnitude. IRI: int:maxNodeVoltage. Unit: V or per unit.

maxLineFlow.description: Maximum allowable apparent power in line segments. IRI: int:maxLineFlow. Unit: VA or per unit.

phaseConfiguration.description: Phase configuration of internal site network. IRI: int:phaseConfiguration.

facilityIds.description: FKs to Facilities belonging to this site. IRI: int:facilityIds.

ownerIds.description: FKs to owner Actors. IRI: int:ownerIds. Nullable if publicly owned.

createdAt.description: Record creation timestamp. IRI: int:createdAt. ISO 8601 with timezone.

updatedAt.description: Record last updated timestamp. IRI: int:updatedAt. ISO 8601 with timezone.
